answer: Make every agent stake a bond behind a kernel of verified history: an identity only earns the right to bid after a long probationary record, the way ivory gains value only as it ages in place. Newcomers begin on a low knoll, capped to trivial trades and watched by random peer audits; a single bad grade freezes the stake. Spawning a thousand fresh identities costs a thousand bonds and buys only the same low cap, so a sybil operator pays far more than the attack can return.
